evidence.section: Model Runtime in Splunk Security Assistant > default behavior and audit-log tags
evidence.statement: Default-on and opt-in descriptions both present.

documentRevision.qualification: Direct response digest; publisher revision unknown.

rationale: The exact ES 8.8 guide describes Model Runtime as enabled by default from ES 8.6 and separately says audit tags are available when users opt in. The wording does not settle effective tenant defaults, opt-in and audit behavior for all deployments.

exclusions: No unlisted feature scope, exact pairing, rollout, entitlement or customer authorization is established.
